name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Hickory-Smoked Half Chicken Platter
whyItWorks: Slow-smoked half chicken with tender white and dark meat. Unbreaded, naturally lean, and low-residue. Great protein source during long park walking days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Half Chicken with baked macaroni & cheese or white bread; peel off crispy skin if feeling sensitive.
